name: 読書の表示を変えるシート
prompt:
Make a narrow correction to image2, the Japanese appearance sheet. Preserve its layout, exact Japanese wording, white ordinary surfaces, selected basic tile, warmcream/papergray preview fills, forest ON toggle/right thumb, OFF toggle/left thumb, mode states and restored source icons. Image1 ORIGINAL remains PRIMARY for icon geometry, fine detail and optical weight; image3 mock is SECONDARY wording/type density only; image4 official style. Do not revert to mock's omissions or mint surfaces.
Correct visibly heavy Japanese type throughout. At logical390px sheet width, title only is Meiryo Bold20 line28. ALL other body labels and option labels are Meiryo REGULAR40014 line24; 「小」Regular14/24 and「大」Regular20/28; numeric「19」Regular12/16; mode labels「スクロール」「めくる」「スライド」Regular12/16; footnoteRegular12/16. Letterspacing0. Reduce stroke/ink weight especially 「端末の設定」「基本」「資料にもテーマを適用」, all three mode labels, 「書体」「メイリオ」「太字」. They must look visibly lighter than title; no semibold/bold. Japanese sample in image3 demonstrates finer regular strokes. Keep original text exact.
Restore the separate small vertical scroll tick to the RIGHT of the rounded document icon immediately before 「スクロール」, as image1. Source Scroll icon is a document plus a separate short vertical tick; do not duplicate any text. Retain all other icons' source geometry. Keep device halfcontrast circle monochrome as original, rest slate #526173. No other modifications, annotations, English, extra UI. One isolated full sheet, high-resolution flat raster.
reviewNotes: Targeted correction inspected: body/mode/value Regular appearance visibly lighter than bold title; separate scroll tick restored. Exact Japanese, source icon/control hierarchy, forest active selection and ON, OFF left, warm/paper theme previews, white ordinary surfaces retained. Fine optical color sampling/native font metrics and interactions unproven. Agent raster visual review only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
